Habitat: House Wren - thickets, open woods, brush; long-billed-marshes;
Rock Wren - rocky areas of plains to high mountains.
Foods: Animal matter such as insects, and spiders.
Name: Trashers and Catbirds - Family Mimidae Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall.
Habitat: Brushy areas. Nests are a twig bowl placed in brush.
Foods: Insects such as ants, beetles, grasshoppers, caterpillars, also spiders, frogs, lizards, buffaloberry, stawberry and corn.
Name: Robin - Turdus migratorius (F. Turdidae)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Open areas anywhere. Likes towns and shortgrass. Nests in mud-grass bowl in trees.
Foods: Caterpillars, beetles, earthworms, currant and wheat.
Miscellaneous: One of our most familiar birds.
Name: Thrushes - Family Turdidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer, Winter.
Habitat: Prefer areas with heavy vegetation growth (thickets, forests, etc.). Nest are usually small cups of leaves, grass and/or twigs.
Foods: Insects, spiders, snails, earthworms, crayfish, pine, gooseberry, sumac, rose and strawberry.
Name: Bluebirds - Family Turdidae (partial)
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Prefer open country with scattered trees. Nests are usually in hollow of tree, cliff, stump or birdbox.
Foods: Insects, spiders, snails, centipedes, poison ivy and sumac.
Name: Kinglets - Family Sylviidae
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Conifers and other densly wooded areas. Nest of moss's in conifers.
Foods: Insects (wasps, flies, beetles, plant lice).
Name: Pipits - Family Motacillidae
Montana resident in: Summer, migratory only.
Habitat: Plains and short-grass prairies. Nest, of grass, on ground.
Foods: Insects, spiders, millipedes, crustaceans. Small guanities of grasses are also utilized.
Miscellaneous: Water Pipit is migratory only.
Name: Bohemian Waxwing - Bombycilla garrula
Montana resident in: Summer.
Habitat: Forests and muskeg. Nest of moss and twigs in conifer.
Foods: Fleshy fruits (hawthorns, cherry, apple strawberry) account for most of diet, also supplemented by insects.
